transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, I've been hearing things. People talking. Mostly at work, through the conference room walls, or even my phone when it's turned off. It's usually the board members or my staff. They say I'm ruining the company. It's so clear that sometimes I... I answer them back before I realize no one else is in the room.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?
Not really. I mean... I wouldn't say I'm sad. Just... trying to manage things.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely happy or irritable and had a lot of energy?
No. I don't think so. I've just been working.
Do you believe what the voices are saying about you ruining the company is true?
I... I don't really know. I just know what I hear them saying. I try to just focus on my work.
Have you ever felt extremely happy or irritable for a period of time?
I... I think you just asked me that. No. I don't really get like that. I just try to keep my head down and work.
Have you ever had a time when you felt extremely energetic?
No. I... I don't know why you keep asking me that. I don't get bursts of energy. Like I said, I just work.
Do you find it hard to organize your thoughts or make decisions at work?

I... I suppose it's been difficult. I can't really... keep up with the basic decisions lately. The senior staff... they've quietly taken over a lot of the work I used to handle for the division. And... well, even at home, my husband has had to manage almost everything. I just... I leave things unfinished, or I just don't start them. It's... it's hard to talk about.
Do you find your thoughts are disjointed or hard to follow when you're trying to think something through?
I... no, I don't think so. I don't really know what you mean by disjointed. They're just... my thoughts. I just can't always figure out what to do next... like I said.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually happy or extremely irritable?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get... unusually happy. Or irritable. I just... I haven't noticed anything like that.
Have you experienced any loss of interest in activities you usually enjoy?

I guess so. I used to... well, I was always the one driving every idea. Calling people after openings. But now... I don't know. I can just sit at my desk for hours. Just staring at the agenda. I barely speak to my staff anymore... or my husband. I just... I feel almost nothing about the work I used to love.
Do you believe the voices you hear are real?

I... I don't know what to believe. They sound real. That's... that's why I came in, I guess. I keep hearing them through the conference room walls. Or from my phone, even when it's completely turned off. It's usually the board members... or my staff. They're saying I'm ruining the company. It's just... it sounds so clear that I actually answer them. Out loud. Just... right before I realize no one else heard it.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely confident or made impulsive decisions?
No. I don't... I don't think I've ever felt like that. I just do my job. Or I try to. I don't make impulsive decisions.
Have you had any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns recently?
I haven't really noticed. I guess... maybe I eat a little less. But I don't know. I'm just tired a lot.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely confident?
I... didn't you just ask me that? I already said no. I don't... I don't feel like that.
Have you had thoughts of self-harm or suicide?
No. I don't... I don't have thoughts like that. No.
How long have you been hearing these voices?
I don't know exactly. Maybe... three months. Just... coming from the walls. Or my phone. About three months, I think.
Have you been feeling hopeless about your situation?
No. I just... I don't know. I'm just tired. I wouldn't say hopeless, just... tired.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely confident and made impulsive decisions that you later regretted?
No. I don't... I don't act like that. I just try to do my work. I haven't made decisions like that. No.
Have you ever had a period where the voices stopped for a while?
No. I... I don't think so. They just... they're just there. I haven't really noticed them stopping.
Have you ever had a period where you felt sad or empty for most of the day?
No. I don't... I wouldn't say empty. I just... I just try to get through the day. I don't really focus on things like that.
